unit.unitinstructions:
Demographic Survey

Please answer the following 5 quick demographic questions, which may be useful for us to understand the data we collect.

🗣 Croatian Phrases

This lesson practices 144 Croatian travel words and short phrases through active recall.

  • What you will do: Some prompts appear as written Croatian and others as spoken audio, and you type the English meaning from memory.
  • Timing: Study and drill screens last about 12 seconds, review screens last about 8 seconds, and correct confirmations last about 0.75 seconds.
  • How it works: Immediate feedback helps connect sound, spelling, and meaning, especially when similar phrases begin to overlap.
  • Why it helps: Adaptive scheduling returns weaker phrases sooner and pushes stronger ones farther out, building both phrase recall and early listening comprehension.

Listen closely, notice repeated roots and patterns, and begin when you are ready.
